name: Czech University of Life Sciences Prague
summary: Prague life-sciences university on one green campus, teaching since 1906; ten English bachelor's in agriculture, forestry, environment and business.

ib.text: CZU's own recognition page says IB Diploma holders need no evaluation, so no extra fee. It asks for no IB points or subjects: each faculty admits on a Scio GAP test or an interview.

dates.label: Applications open for 2027 entry (FLD and FTZ from 14 September)

programmes.name: Agricultural Engineering
programmes.about: Three years of agricultural technology: two years of theory that lead on to technical or biological study, then applied engineering and a bachelor thesis, for farm, forestry and municipal enterprises or a technical master's.
programmes.overview: The first two years give a theoretical grounding in agricultural technology, drawing on technical and biological sciences, and the final year turns to applying that knowledge in practice. Your undergraduate thesis in the final year doubles as a way to specialise, for example in biological systems engineering. Graduates can start work or continue to advanced technical degrees, with openings in agricultural and forestry enterprises, municipal production, technical development, and the design and operation of information, automation and control systems, as well as in the food industry.
programmes.ib: Online oral interview in maths, physics and English; no IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral interview on maths, physics, general knowledge and English, scored out of 30; 15 needed, about 15 admitted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Agriculture and Food
programmes.about: How food is made from farm to fork: agricultural practice, plant and animal biology, nutrition, soil and microbes, with food quality and technology in the last year and practicals in the university's food facilities and labs.
programmes.overview: You learn agricultural practices and what makes agriculture sustainable, plant and animal biology, nutritional needs, microbiology and soil and the environment, and the final year concentrates on food quality and technology. Practical training takes place in the university's food demonstration facilities and food analysis laboratories. Graduates can build careers in the food sector in the Czech Republic and abroad, in government organisations, food industry companies and small and medium-sized firms working in agriculture and food.
programmes.ib: Online Scio GAP test; the faculty sets no grade or subject requirement from your earlier schooling.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Scio GAP test; a percentile of 40 or more can be admitted, best percentile first until the 75 places are filled.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Economics, management, commercial law, accounting, psychology and business ethics, taught entirely in English, for careers in management, trade, accountancy, banking and agribusiness, or a follow-on master's.
programmes.overview: The degree is taught entirely in English and covers economics, management, commercial law, accounting, psychology and business ethics, with faculty who cooperate with European universities. The programme is broad rather than split into tracks, with particular attention to agribusiness. Graduates move on to related master's programmes or into service firms, consulting, processing industries, financial institutions, authorities and local or regional administration, in roles such as management, trade, accountancy, banking, administration and marketing.
programmes.ib: The entrance exam is Scio's online GAP test in maths and English, paid to Scio directly. No IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on Scio's online GAP test (0-100, maths and English); the committee sets a pass threshold each stage. One attempt per stage; a GAP result from 2023-26 can be uploaded.
programmes.closesNote: Five stages; the last closes 31 March 2027

programmes.name: Economics and Management
programmes.about: Economics, finance, accounting and agricultural economics, with law, statistics, operations research and informatics, for management roles in firms, services and administration or a follow-on master's.
programmes.overview: The programme covers economics, management, finance, accounting and agricultural economics, supported by law, statistics, operations research and informatics, and widened by psychology, political science, sociology and philosophy for context. There are no formal tracks. Graduates can apply to related master's programmes or go straight into management roles in small and medium-sized firms and large corporations, service companies, consultancies, processing enterprises, financial institutions and public administration.
programmes.ib: The entrance exam is Scio's online GAP test in maths and English, paid to Scio directly. No IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on Scio's online GAP test (0-100, maths and English); the committee sets a pass threshold each stage. One attempt per stage; a GAP result from 2023-26 can be uploaded.
programmes.closesNote: Five stages; the last closes 31 March 2027

programmes.name: Environmental Data Science
programmes.about: Environmental science joined to data science: GIS, programming in R and Python, machine learning, big data and hydrology, with labs, fieldwork and a thesis; compulsory courses in years one and two, electives in year three.
programmes.overview: The three years combine environmental science with data skills: the first year covers algorithm development, GIS, physical geography and applied mathematics, and the second adds geodatabases, machine learning and remote sensing, with programming in R and Python, big data analysis and hydrology across the course. Teaching leans on laboratory work, fieldwork and practical projects with advanced software and online tutorials, and the thesis is developed in years two and three. Graduates work in environmental consulting, government agencies, NGOs, research institutions and technology companies building environmental solutions.
programmes.ib: Scio GAP test is the entrance exam; no IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on Scio's GAP test (0-100); the committee sets the pass threshold each phase; up to 70 admitted. A GAP result from the previous two years counts.
programmes.closesNote: A second phase runs 1 February to 31 March 2027

programmes.name: Environmental Engineering
programmes.about: Environmental protection and natural resource management: earth sciences, environmental chemistry, remediation of contaminated sites and climate-change impacts, with seminars, field workshops and year-three electives.
programmes.overview: The degree builds a broad understanding of environmental protection with an emphasis on managing natural resources, through earth sciences, environmental chemistry, remediation of contamination, and software for processing environmental data. The first two years include seminars and field workshops, practical documentation work such as spatial and management plans and environmental impact studies, and laboratory and field assessment. In the third year you choose electives to strengthen your focus. Graduates can prepare management plans for soil and water, assess pollution and propose climate mitigation measures, or continue to a master's degree.
programmes.ib: Scio GAP test is the entrance exam; no IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on Scio's GAP test (0-100); the committee sets the pass threshold each phase; up to 70 admitted. A GAP result from the previous two years counts.
programmes.closesNote: A second phase runs 1 February to 31 March 2027

programmes.name: Informatics
programmes.about: An IT bachelor taught in English for work in software firms, consulting, finance and public administration, with the option of continuing to a related master's programme.
programmes.overview: The degree trains IT specialists who also understand the business side, with theoretical and practical knowledge of informatics, economics, management, commerce, bookkeeping and law, so that they can work as equal partners to IT specialists in organisations. You learn to apply information and communication technology to organisational processes and take part in shaping information strategy. The final state exam covers economics and management, quantitative methods, and computer systems and information engineering. Graduates work in specialised software firms, consultancies, financial institutions and state administration, or continue to a master's.
programmes.ib: The entrance exam is Scio's online GAP test in maths and English, paid to Scio directly. No IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on Scio's online GAP test (0-100, maths and English); the committee sets a pass threshold each stage. One attempt per stage; a GAP result from 2023-26 can be uploaded.
programmes.closesNote: Five stages; the last closes 31 March 2027

programmes.name: International Cooperation in Agriculture and Rural Development
programmes.about: Preparation for international technical-assistance projects in rural development: project management, intercultural communication, biology for agriculture, a personal-security course and compulsory practical training with NGOs, agencies or firms.
programmes.overview: The degree prepares you for international technical assistance projects in rural development and agriculture, tackling poverty and food security in developing countries while protecting the environment. You develop project management, international communication and multicultural team management skills, with applied biology of agricultural production. Mandatory practical training in non-profit organisations, government institutions or private companies working in development grounds the theory. Graduates work in development organisations, government agencies and private firms on agricultural and rural development.
programmes.ib: Written World Geography and English test, waived with a school GPA of 1.6 or better on a Czech-comparable scale; ask FTZ whether IB grades qualify.
programmes.selectionNote: Round 1 scores your CV (20) and school results (30), 30 needed; then a geography and English test, 45 of 100 to pass, ranked on points; up to 80 admitted.
programmes.closesNote: Stage 2 applications run 16 January to 31 March 2027

programmes.name: Sustainable Forestry and Natural Resource Management
programmes.about: Forest and non-forest ecosystems, bioeconomy and sustainable natural resource management, with economics, law, GIS, remote sensing and data analysis, and a compulsory semester abroad at a partner university in year two.
programmes.overview: You study how forest and non-forest ecosystems function, bioeconomics, and the sustainable management of natural resources, including their economic, legal and marketing sides, with climate change as a recurring theme. Teaching combines theory with modern tools such as GIS, remote sensing, artificial intelligence and data analysis, and builds communication, teamwork and information skills. The course is international in outlook. Graduates can move to the follow-up master's in Forest Science in Global Change, or work with development organisations, EU institutions and international bodies.
programmes.ib: Interview in English on biology, your motivation and your ability to communicate in English; no IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Interview in English on biology, motivation and communication; one exam date in February 2027, an alternative in June 2027.

programmes.name: Sustainable Use of Natural Resources
programmes.about: Managing the sustainable use of natural resources with soil and water at the centre and a link to food production; classes, excursions and practical training for government, consultancy or research work, or a master's.
programmes.overview: You learn how to manage natural resources sustainably while supporting human development, with special attention to food production and the roles of soil and water. Teaching mixes classes, excursions and practical training to prepare you for specialist work in resource management and conservation. Graduates can work as officials in agricultural or environmental ministries, as consultants or NGO staff in soil, water and waste management, or as early-career researchers, and can continue to master's programmes in natural resources and environment, or natural resources management and ecological engineering.
programmes.ib: Online Scio GAP test; the faculty sets no grade or subject requirement from your earlier schooling.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Scio GAP test; a percentile of 40 or more can be admitted, best percentile first until the 60 places are filled.

notes: English-taught study is charged to EU citizens too: CZK 12,500 a year at four faculties, about CZK 13,000 at Engineering and Tropical AgriSciences; non-EU students pay CZK 25,000-80,000.

Some faculty regulations still ask for nostrification of a foreign diploma; CZU's recognition page says the IB Diploma is recognised automatically, so point the faculty to it and send the diploma at enrolment.
Each faculty runs its own application (CZK 850 each, non-refundable) and its own test: applying to two faculties means paying and testing twice.
